title: Tek bir ürün nesnesi (Products list ve detail response'larında ortak, reusable)
description: Kaynak: QA-DEMO-SYSTEM/backend/src/services/products.service.js — toApiShape(): { id, name, price, stock_quantity, in_stock }.
